title: Research note: price a width-9 spectral split with dirty restoration
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Research note and scoped negative cost result; no new κ.** This adds one standalone package investigating whether a width-9 complex residual can be hosted across width-4 and width-5 owners by changing the recursive interface.

For every integer `f >= 1`, exact eigenspace counts admit an explicit encoder into `C_(4f) direct-sum C_(5f)`. Its complementary workspace action is a known diagonal phase, so one additional phase pass restores arbitrary dirty inputs. This changes the hypotheses of #451's routing/similarity obstruction; it does not contradict that obstruction or validate #448's original priced word.

The complete boundary bill rejects this particular implementation as an improvement. The literal profile is `2 C_(9f) + 3 C_(4f) + 3 C_(5f)`, with moment ratio at least 5 relative to one residual. Granting both owner calls for free still leaves ratio at least 4. Collapsing the host sandwiches leaves two width-9f transforms; collapsing the entire operator recovers the original single call. Routing, source access, workspace, normalization, phase restoration, preparation and precision are explicitly included. This is a scoped result for the stated encoder, not a lower bound for all encoded hosting.

Base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. Assignment seed **51**, recursive interfaces; `4 = 1 + (51 mod 8)` selects the split. The accepted #626/#543 record remains `51110230636731/31250000000000000`. No existing file or `upstream/` byte changes.

[Research note](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d0e4f1eb295e5cce508dc76c6937290a9175e42b/research/clean-residual-dilation/README.md), [exact certificate](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d0e4f1eb295e5cce508dc76c6937290a9175e42b/research/clean-residual-dilation/CERTIFICATE.json), [source pins](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d0e4f1eb295e5cce508dc76c6937290a9175e42b/research/clean-residual-dilation/SOURCE-PINS.json), and [completed local claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d0e4f1eb295e5cce508dc76c6937290a9175e42b/research/clean-residual-dilation/CLAIM.json).

No pinned coordination issue existed at either check. The pre-submission refresh covered 484 open PRs. New #663 audits #628's nonlinear dirty commutator and leaf count; this note studies the distinct linear spectral encoding above. #661/#662/#664 concern fixed-order bit frames, Clifford verification speed, and entrance promotions. No matching claimed scope was found.

The note credits Sreekanth Nair / higherbeing's #448, Chafik Boukhalfa's #451, hipotures / RaD's single-stream audit, icekylinx's exact frame interface, the selected Kothe/Boukhalfa/eumemic construction lineage, and the earlier Fourier-boundary diagnostic. Prepared by Douglas R. Colkitt with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, under Apache-2.0.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -B research/clean-residual-dilation/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_EXACT_DILATION_AND_UNFAVORABLE_BOUNDARY_BUDGET`.

- Full exact replay: 512 source columns, 512 dirty workspace columns, and all 512 repaired columns; an independent tensor-entry reference; 1024 Walsh-to-child checks; and all 1024 columns of the collapsed circuit.
- Exact binomial/DP agreement through width 288, plus dilation counts for `f=1,...,32`. A separate written averaging argument proves the capacity inequality for all `f`; finite enumeration is not described as its proof.
- Eight mathematical negative controls, including missing eigenspaces, an invalid route, omitted boundaries/owner calls/normalization, and failed dirty restoration.
- Isolated optimized and relocated replays pass. Corrupted inherited source and corrupted expected certificate both fail under `-I -O`.
- `make selected-record-check`, artifact hashes, local links, staged whitespace and preservation checks pass. The replay takes approximately four seconds on macOS / Python 3.14.6, standard library only.

No full repository suite, cold supplier replay, Linux CI or Lean pass is claimed. No ownership schedule, all-size tape compiler, numerical rounding theorem, or multiplication theorem is supplied by this local interface. These remain explicit scope limits.
